text:
michael: quick sync — planning to enable 'burst_capacity_v2' flag in prod tomorrow 09:00 PT. Canary target: 5% of traffic (route hashing). Need to confirm queueing soft-cap and max_concurrency guardrail values. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/flags/1234 Deploy window 1h. Thoughts?

dina: i'd prefer starting at 3% not 5%. we saw p99 blips at 5% last quarter. can ramp if stable. also double-check queueing weight default (0.25).

julia: can we split canary by customer_tier instead of route? makes rollback simpler for enterprise customers. @michael do we have tier->route mapping ready?

praveen: mapping exists in infra config. i'll post the snippet and recommended guardrail numbers. my suggestion: max_concurrency per worker = 64, queue_soft_limit = 250.

praveen: ```yaml
canary:
  pct: 3
  selector: customer_tier == "free"
worker:
  max_concurrency: 64
  queue_soft_limit: 250
```

michael: ok thanks — 3% and tier-based selector sounds good. i'll update the PR to those values. who can watch metrics during the rollout? need p99 latency, queue_length, request_timeouts, gpu_util, error_rate.

leo: I can monitor first 30m. i'll wire up a quick grafana panel and add alerts: >2x baseline p99 or queue_length >500.

julia: add alert for sustained queue >400 for 5m too. also ensure fallback model variant is configured to keep tail errors low when capacity hits guardrail.

deploy-bot: scheduled flag enable 2026-05-05T16:00:00Z for canary audience 3% (free tier). Rollout window 60m. Initiator: michael. Rollback: automatic if alert triggers.

oncall-bot: runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rollouts/burst-capacity. Oncall assigned: @leo. Playbook: disable flag -> verify traffic returns to baseline; if not, escalate to eng-sre.

dina: small note — ensure the max_concurrency guardrail is enforced in the worker start script; left a PR comment.

praveen: updated the PR with tier selector + guardrail config. PTAL: https://git.redwood/infra/flags/1234#diff

michael: thanks. i'll merge at 15:45 and schedule deploy-bot for 16:00. @leo please ack when you start monitoring.

leo: ack — i'll be online from 15:50. :eyes:

julia: quick staging test passed with queueing weight 0.25 and max_concurrency 64. no regressions seen.

michael: one more check — do we want a warmup/grace window for the autoscaler to warm up? i'd suggest 10m.

praveen: added warmup_window: 10m in the rollout config.

leo: dashboard up and alerting wired. i'll post updates every 15m during the rollout.

deploy-bot: preflight checks OK: infra_health=green, capacity_headroom=30%.

michael: great — thanks everyone. i'll post final status after the 60m canary.
